observations: 039 exact actual mod setup/AffixManager registers ReflectiveAffix. Its BasicAffix constructor third argument true registers this instance on Forge EVENT_BUS; actual ChampionEventsHandler onLivingDamage server gate separately calls installed affix onDamage. No listener order or final native damage application guarantee.

onDamage requires directEntity LivingEntity, excludes source msgId reflection or EntityDamageSource.isThorns, creates new EntityDamageSource(reflection, champion), calls setThorns and copies selected source flags. Computes min(original amount * random fraction, reflectiveMax), invokes sourceEntity.hurt, ignores returned boolean and returns unchanged newAmount. Callback uses original amount rather than accumulated newAmount from previous affixes. These are direct source observations, not confirmed reflected health loss.

onDamageEvent is independently subscribed. If reflectiveLethal false and source.getMsgId equals reflection, amount>=target.health becomes health-1. It has no explicit side/target-champion/direct-source/positive-health guard and does not cancel the event. A target with health<1 yields a negative assignment; no native engine interpretation asserted. Same message string is not authenticated as produced by this affix.

Neither complete method emits a dedicated sound/text/particle/packet receipt or retains a new state; copied source flags and arbitrary-message cap are not separate references. Broader final damage pipeline and other listeners can change settlement.

Config symbol search located defaults, declarations and bake assignments only; full config constructor/bake was not read for this bounded screen and is not cited as a complete verified configuration chain. No runtime or cross-project thorns integration claim.
